verdicts.reason: A actually rearranges the banner into a stacked square, but the logo is oversized and outweighs the small 'Three talks this week' headline. The leftover divider rules are stray: one runs from the logo's top edge to the right margin, and one cuts under the THU row. The list is indented off the headline's left edge, and 'All free, all at 19:00.' sits detached below the list. B is just the banner's three columns stretched vertically, with huge dead gaps between the TUE/WED/THU rows and between the headline and its subcopy. The logo is tiny with an illegible 'GALLERY' line, so it reads as a stretched banner rather than a composed design.
